label: Bible Study
prompt: Before I formed thee in the _____ I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verse: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
note: Jeremiah's call — known before he was formed; the KJV says 'belly' first and 'womb' second.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand _____, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verse: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
note: Sea in front, Pharaoh's chariots behind — and Moses's battle plan is 'stand still.' It worked.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when they were come into the _____, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
verse: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
note: By the time the wise men arrived, the KJV has the young child in a house — the manger scene was behind them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no _____ in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verse: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
note: God swears by his own life that he wants the wicked to turn and live — then pleads, 'turn ye, turn ye.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the _____ of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
verse: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
note: A shout, the archangel's voice, and 'the trump of God' — the KJV keeps the old short form of trumpet.
